Secret.description:
A pairing credential, manual code or device token. Serializes as a plain
string; `Debug` never prints the value, so it cannot reach logs or error
strings through a derived impl.

description: What the QR code encodes. Compact JSON; see [`qr_payload`].

address.description: `host:port` of the WebSocket listener, never an unspecified address.

host_name.description: The host's own name, for display; cut to keep the code scannable.
